series.name: Modern H/F self-diagnosis codes (all current residential splits, PK XKF/YE/PC/C class)
series.notes: Modern letter+digit scheme shared by all current Panasonic residential inverter/conventional splits (H00-H99, F11-F99). Primary = official Panasonic self-diagnosis page (name source of truth) + CS-E7JKEW service manual §16.3/§16.4 causes + NA operating manual corroboration. High for dual-official entries; medium for official-name-only (16 entries, flagged in notes). Remote display.

title.en: No fault stored (no memory of failure)
title.ur: Koi fault save nahi hai

meaning.en: Self-diagnosis reports no abnormality — the unit is working normally.
meaning.ur: Self-diagnosis mein koi kharabi nahi mili, unit normal chal rahi hai.

notes.en: Baseline code on every inverter model — scroll starts at H00. No TIMER LED blink stored.
notes.ur: Har inverter model mein yeh baseline code hai — scroll H00 se shuru hota hai. Is mein koi TIMER LED blink save nahi hota.

title.ur: Indoor aur outdoor ka communication nahi ho raha

meaning.en: The indoor and outdoor units failed to talk to each other shortly after start-up, so the unit stops.
meaning.ur: Start ke kuch second ke andar indoor aur outdoor mein signal exchange nahi hua, is liye unit band ho gayi.

causes.en: Inter-unit wiring loose, wrongly landed on terminals, or wrong wire count
causes.ur: Indoor–outdoor wire terminal pe dhili ya galat lagi hui hai

causes.en: Break/cut in the connection cable between indoor and outdoor
causes.ur: Connection wire ke beech se toota hua ya kata hua hai

causes.en: Faulty indoor PCB, outdoor PCB, or disturbed power supply waveform
causes.ur: Indoor PCB, outdoor PCB kharab ho sakta hai ya supply waveform theek nahi

solutions.en: Switch off the breaker and re-check both terminals and the inter-unit cable
solutions.ur: Breaker band karke dono terminal aur inter-unit wire dobara check karein

solutions.en: Look for a cut/burn in the cable and replace the wire if damaged
solutions.ur: Wire mein cut ya jalan hai to nayi wire lagwayein

solutions.en: Wiring OK? Then test indoor and outdoor PCBs with a service technician
solutions.ur: Wiring theek hai to technician se indoor/outdoor PCB check karwayein

notes.en: Most-searched Panasonic code. Trip: detected after ~1 min of operation; indoor fan can still run in force-cooling. Timer LED blinks while stored.
notes.ur: Yeh Panasonic ka sabse zyada search hone wala code hai. Trip: taqreeban 1 minute chalne ke baad pakda jata hai; force-cooling mein indoor fan phir bhi chal sakta hai. Code save honay par Timer LED blink karta hai.

title.ur: Indoor aur outdoor ka capacity match nahi hai

meaning.en: The connected indoor and outdoor units are not a valid pair, or the total indoor capacity is outside the allowed range.
meaning.ur: Lagaaye hue indoor aur outdoor ki jodi sahi nahi hai ya indoor ki total capacity limit se bahar hai.

causes.en: Wrong models interconnected (capacity rank does not match)
causes.ur: Galat model joda hua hai, capacity rank match nahi karti

causes.en: Wrong or defective indoor/outdoor PCB fitted
causes.ur: Indoor ya outdoor PCB galat ya kharab lagaya hua hai

causes.en: Wiring break or wrong wiring between the units
causes.ur: Indoor–outdoor wire mein cut ya wiring galat hai

solutions.en: Match indoor and outdoor model numbers against the catalogue combination table
solutions.ur: Indoor aur outdoor ke model number catalogue ki combination table se milayein

solutions.en: Check that the number of indoor units and total capacity is within the outdoor unit limit
solutions.ur: Indoor units ki tadaad aur total capacity outdoor ki limit ke andar hai — check karein

solutions.en: Verify the inter-unit wiring and PCB part numbers
solutions.ur: Inter-unit wiring aur PCB ke part numbers verify karein

notes.en: Appears 90 s after power-up. Usually an install/combo mistake, not a part failure.
notes.ur: Power-up ke 90 second baad aata hai. Aksar yeh install ya combo ka ghalat hona hota hai, koi part kharab nahi hota.

title.en: Indoor intake air temperature sensor fault
title.ur: Indoor ki room temperature sensor theek kaam nahi kar rahi

meaning.en: The room (intake) thermistor reads open or short for 5 seconds, so the sensor value cannot be trusted.
meaning.ur: Room ki temperature sensor open/short ho gayi hai, is liye unit us reading par kaam nahi kar sakti.

causes.en: Sensor connector loose or not seated on the indoor PCB
causes.ur: Sensor ka connector PCB pe theek se laga nahi ya dhila hai

causes.en: Thermistor itself open/short (damaged or wet)
causes.ur: Thermistor khud open/short ho gaya hai — kharab ya geela ho sakta hai

causes.en: Faulty indoor PCB input
causes.ur: Indoor PCB ka sensor input hissa kharab hai

solutions.en: Power off, unplug the intake thermistor and reseat the connector
solutions.ur: Power band karke thermistor ka connector nikal ke dobara lagayein

solutions.en: Measure the sensor with a multimeter and replace if open/short
solutions.ur: Multimeter se sensor check karein, open/short ho to sensor badlein

solutions.en: If the sensor is fine, have the indoor PCB checked
solutions.ur: Sensor theek ho to indoor PCB check karwayein

notes.en: Trip: value open/short for 5 s. Check location per manual: sensor lead wire and connector.
notes.ur: Trip: value 5 second tak open/short rahe. Manual ke mutabiq jagah check karein: sensor ki lead wire aur connector.

title.ur: Compressor ki temperature sensor theek nahi

meaning.en: The outdoor compressor (discharge/bottom) thermistor reads open or short for 5 seconds.
meaning.ur: Outdoor compressor ki temperature sensor open/short par rahi hai, is liye protection lag gayi.

causes.en: Compressor sensor connector loose or corroded
causes.ur: Compressor sensor ka connector dhila ya zang laga hua hai

causes.en: Thermistor open/short (heat damage at the compressor)
causes.ur: Thermistor kharab — compressor ki garmi se wire/sensor toot gaya

causes.en: Faulty outdoor PCB sensor circuit
causes.ur: Outdoor PCB ka sensor circuit kharab hai

solutions.en: Kill power, then inspect and reseat the compressor sensor plug
solutions.ur: Power band karke compressor sensor ka plug check karke dobara lagayein

solutions.en: Test the thermistor resistance and replace it if out of range
solutions.ur: Thermistor ki resistance check karein, range se bahar ho to badlein

solutions.en: If sensor and wiring are good, check the outdoor PCB
solutions.ur: Sensor aur wire theek ho to outdoor PCB check karein

notes.en: Trip: open/short for 5 s. PK units run long hours in high ambient — sensor leads at the compressor often heat-damaged.
notes.ur: Trip: 5 second tak open/short. PK units zyada ambient mein lambe ghante chalte hain — compressor ke paas sensor ki leads aksar heat se kharab ho jati hain.

title.ur: Outdoor mein compressor ka current detect nahi ho raha

meaning.en: The outdoor board cannot see compressor current through the CT, so it assumes the CT/compressor path is faulty.
meaning.ur: Outdoor board compressor ka current nahi dekh paa raha, is liye CT ya compressor mein fault maan liya.

causes.en: CT (current transformer) on the outdoor PCB defective
causes.ur: Outdoor PCB laga hua CT kharab hai

causes.en: Outdoor PCB faulty (CT sensing circuit)
causes.ur: Outdoor PCB kharab hai (current sensing part)

causes.en: Compressor defective with low compression / not drawing current
causes.ur: Compressor khud kharab ho, compression low ho ya current na le raha ho

solutions.en: Check compressor amp draw with a clamp meter during start-up
solutions.ur: Start ke waqt clamp meter se compressor ke ampere check karein

solutions.en: Inspect the CT solder joints and connector on the outdoor board
solutions.ur: Outdoor board pe CT ke joint aur connector check karein

solutions.en: If CT and amps are normal, suspect the outdoor PCB or compressor
solutions.ur: CT aur ampere normal ho to outdoor PCB ya compressor par shak karein

notes.en: Trip: compressor at rated frequency but CT input < 0.65 A for 20 s. Frequently mis-read online as 'low gas' — it is a current-sense fault.
notes.ur: Trip: compressor rated frequency par chal raha hai lekin CT input 20 second tak < 0.65 A. Log ise online aksar 'low gas' samajh lete hain — asal mein yeh current-sense fault hai.

title.ur: Outdoor suction temperature sensor theek nahi

meaning.en: The outdoor suction gas temperature sensor is reported abnormal by the official table.
meaning.ur: Official table ke mutabiq outdoor suction gas temperature sensor abnormal hai.

causes.en: Suction thermistor open/short or connector loose
causes.ur: Suction thermistor open/short hai ya connector dhila hai

causes.en: Outdoor PCB sensor input faulty
causes.ur: Outdoor PCB ka sensor input kharab hai

solutions.en: Locate the suction (gas inlet) sensor at the outdoor service valve and reseat its plug
solutions.ur: Outdoor service valve ke paas suction sensor ka plug nikal ke dobara lagayein

solutions.en: Measure the thermistor and replace it if open/short
solutions.ur: Thermistor ki reading lein, open/short ho to badlein

notes.en: Official name only — no cause list published. Causes follow the same sensor-check pattern the service manual gives for H27/H28; verify on your model.
notes.ur: Sirf official name mili hai — koi cause list shaya nahi hui. Causes wohi sensor-check wala pattern hain jo service manual H27/H28 ke liye deta hai; apne model par verify karein.

title.ur: Indoor ka fan atka hua hai / chal nahi raha

meaning.en: The indoor DC fan's feedback speed is far outside normal range, so the fan is locked or its feedback has failed.
meaning.ur: Indoor fan ki speed normal range se bahar hai — fan atka hai ya uska feedback signal nahi aa raha.

causes.en: Cross-flow fan blocked (dust, foreign object) or motor winding short/open
causes.ur: Cross-flow fan mein rukawat/gandagi hai ya motor ki winding short/open hai

causes.en: Fan lead wire broken or connector not making contact
causes.ur: Fan ki lead wire tooti hui hai ya connector contact nahi kar raha

causes.en: Hall IC failure or faulty indoor PCB
causes.ur: Hall IC kharab hai ya indoor PCB fault hai

solutions.en: Power off, open the indoor and spin the cross-flow fan by hand for jamming
solutions.ur: Power band karke indoor khol karke haath se cross-flow fan ghumayein — atak raha ho to safai karein

solutions.en: Check the fan connector and continuity of the motor leads
solutions.ur: Fan ka connector aur motor leads ki continuity check karein

solutions.en: Replace the indoor fan motor if it is jammed or the winding is open
solutions.ur: Fan motor atka ho ya winding open ho to motor badlein

notes.en: Trip: Hall-IC feedback > 2550 rpm or < 50 rpm, counted 7 times continuously. Check location: fan lead wire/connector, fan lock/blockage.
notes.ur: Trip: Hall-IC feedback 2550 rpm se zyada ya 50 rpm se kam, 7 baar lagatar count hota hai. Jagah check karein: fan ki lead wire/connector, fan ka lock ya rukawat.

title.ur: Indoor ka float switch trip hua hai (pani)

meaning.en: The indoor drain pan float switch has opened, which normally means water is not draining away.
meaning.ur: Indoor ki drain tray ka float switch khul gaya — aam tor par pani drain nahi ho raha.

causes.en: Blocked drain pipe or sloped/wrong pipe installation
causes.ur: Drain pipe block hai ya pipe ka level/gradient galat hai

causes.en: Dirty drain tray/pump not lifting water
causes.ur: Drain tray gandi hai ya drain pump pani nahi utha rahi

solutions.en: Power off, clear the drain hose and blow through it
solutions.ur: Power band karke drain hose saaf karein aur hawa se clear karein

solutions.en: Level the indoor unit and check the pump/float for sticking
solutions.ur: Indoor unit ka level sahi karein aur pump/float check karein

notes.en: Official name only — no cause list published; causes are the standard float-switch fault set (blocked drain). Water-leak risk: stop and clear the drain.
notes.ur: Sirf official name hai — cause list shaya nahi hui; causes standard float-switch wale hain (drain band hona). Paani leak hone ka khatra: unit band karein aur drain saaf karein.

title.en: Indoor heat exchanger temperature sensor 1 fault
title.ur: Indoor pipe (coil) ka pehla sensor theek nahi

meaning.en: The indoor pipe/HX sensor 1 reads open or short for 5 seconds.
meaning.ur: Indoor pipe ka pehla sensor 5 second tak open/short par raha hai.

causes.en: Sensor connector loose or corroded at the indoor PCB
causes.ur: Sensor ka connector indoor PCB pe dhila ya zang laga hua hai

causes.en: Pipe thermistor open/short (bulged clip or wet coil)
causes.ur: Pipe thermistor open/short — clip toot gaya ya coil geela hai

causes.en: Faulty indoor PCB input
causes.ur: Indoor PCB ka sensor input kharab hai

solutions.en: Reseat the pipe sensor connector and refit the sensor clip on the copper pipe
solutions.ur: Sensor ka connector dobara lagayein aur clip copper pipe pe theek se lagayein

solutions.en: Measure the thermistor and replace it if open/short
solutions.ur: Thermistor ki reading lein, open/short ho to badlein

solutions.en: If the sensor reads fine, check the indoor PCB
solutions.ur: Sensor reading theek ho to indoor PCB check karein

notes.en: Also appears in cooling-only emergency operation. Urdu/Hindi technician videos use exactly this wording (see source 20).
notes.ur: Cooling-only emergency operation mein bhi aata hai. Urdu/Hindi technician videos isi lafz ko use karti hain (source 20 dekhein).

title.en: Indoor heat exchanger temperature sensor 2 fault
title.ur: Indoor pipe (coil) ka doosra sensor theek nahi

meaning.en: The second indoor heat exchanger sensor reads open or short for 5 seconds (models with two pipe sensors).
meaning.ur: Doosre indoor pipe sensor ki reading 5 second tak open/short hai — do sensor wale models par.

causes.en: Second pipe thermistor open/short or connector loose
causes.ur: Doosra pipe thermistor open/short hai ya connector dhila hai

causes.en: Wiring between sensor 2 and indoor PCB damaged
causes.ur: Sensor 2 aur indoor PCB ke beech wire kharab hai

solutions.en: Identify sensor 2 on the coil (usually the second row/branch) and reseat its plug
solutions.ur: Coil pe doosra sensor dhoond karke uska plug dobara lagayein

solutions.en: Measure and replace the thermistor if open/short
solutions.ur: Thermistor measure karein, open/short ho to badlein

source.title: Panasonic RE9SKUA/RE12SKUA operating manual (diagnostic display list)

notes.en: Name confirmed by official page + official NA manual (2 official sources). Trip condition 'continues for 5 s' from the service-manual table.
notes.ur: Naam official page aur official NA manual se confirm hua hai (2 official sources). Trip condition '5 second tak jari rahe' service-manual table se li gayi hai.

title.ur: Indoor e-ion/ion device kaam nahi kar raha

meaning.en: The indoor e-ion air-purifying unit reported a fault while it was switched off.
meaning.ur: E-ion (air purifier) unit ne fault report kiya jab woh band thi.

causes.en: Faulty indoor main PCB
causes.ur: Indoor main PCB kharab hai

causes.en: Faulty e-ion power module
causes.ur: E-ion power module kharab hai

solutions.en: Switch the e-ion function off and restart the unit to confirm the code clears
solutions.ur: E-ion function band karke unit restart karein, code clear ho jaye to theek

solutions.en: Have the e-ion module and indoor PCB checked by a technician
solutions.ur: Technician se e-ion module aur indoor PCB check karwayein

notes.en: Trip: e-ion breakdown during standby, unit stops. Models without e-ion never show it. Official page wordings: 'Indoor ion device abnormality'.
notes.ur: Trip: standby ke doran e-ion breakdown, unit band ho jata hai. Jis models mein e-ion nahi hota woh kabhi yeh nahi dikhata. Official page ka lafz: 'Indoor ion device abnormality'.

title.ur: Minus ION feature fault hai

meaning.en: The minus-ION air-purification function reported a fault.
meaning.ur: Minus ION (air purification) function ne fault bataya hai.

causes.en: Minus-ION generator/module faulty
causes.ur: Minus ION module kharab hai

causes.en: Indoor PCB drive circuit for the function faulty
causes.ur: Indoor PCB ka ION drive circuit kharab hai

solutions.en: Turn the ION function off, power cycle the unit and see if the code stays away
solutions.ur: ION function band karke power cycle karein, code wapas na aaye to theek

solutions.en: Get the ION module/indoor PCB checked if the code returns
solutions.ur: Code wapas aaye to ION module/indoor PCB check karwayein

notes.en: Official name only — no cause list published; closely related to H25 (ion device family).
notes.ur: Sirf official naam hai — cause list shaya nahi hui; H25 (ion device family) se qareeb mutaalliq hai.

title.ur: Outdoor ambient temperature sensor theek nahi

meaning.en: The outdoor ambient thermistor reads open or short for 5 seconds.
meaning.ur: Outdoor ambient (hawa) sensor 5 second tak open/short par raha hai.

causes.en: Ambient sensor connector loose/corroded at the outdoor PCB
causes.ur: Outdoor PCB pe sensor connector dhila ya zang laga hua hai

causes.en: Thermistor open/short (rodent damage or water ingress)
causes.ur: Thermistor open/short — choohay ne kaat liya ya paani ghus gaya

causes.en: Faulty outdoor PCB input
causes.ur: Outdoor PCB ka sensor input kharab hai

solutions.en: Reseat the outdoor ambient sensor plug and inspect the lead for damage
solutions.ur: Sensor ka plug dobara lagayein aur wire mein damage check karein

solutions.en: Measure and replace the thermistor if open/short
solutions.ur: Thermistor measure karein, open/short ho to badlein

solutions.en: Check the outdoor PCB if the sensor is good
solutions.ur: Sensor theek ho to outdoor PCB check karein

notes.en: Ambient sensor drives defrost and T3 protection — a bad reading also causes weak cooling.
notes.ur: Ambient sensor defrost aur T3 protection ko control karta hai — ghalat reading se cooling bhi kamzor ho jati hai.

title.en: Outdoor heat exchanger temperature sensor 1 fault
title.ur: Outdoor coil (condenser) ka pehla sensor theek nahi

meaning.en: The outdoor coil sensor 1 reads open or short for 5 seconds.
meaning.ur: Outdoor coil ka pehla sensor 5 second tak open/short par raha hai.

causes.en: Outdoor pipe thermistor open/short or connector loose
causes.ur: Outdoor pipe thermistor open/short hai ya connector dhila hai

causes.en: Sensor lead damaged at the fan/grille
causes.ur: Sensor ki wire fan/grille ke paas toot gayi hai

causes.en: Faulty outdoor PCB input
causes.ur: Outdoor PCB ka sensor input kharab hai

solutions.en: Reseat the coil sensor plug and refit the clip on the condenser pipe
solutions.ur: Sensor ka plug dobara lagayein aur clip condenser pipe pe lagayein

solutions.en: Measure and replace the thermistor if open/short
solutions.ur: Thermistor measure karein, open/short ho to badlein

solutions.en: Check the outdoor PCB if the sensor is good
solutions.ur: Sensor theek ho to outdoor PCB check karein

notes.en: Trip: open/short for 5 s. Drives high-pressure and defrost decisions — replace promptly.
notes.ur: Trip: 5 second tak open/short. High-pressure aur defrost ke faisle isi se hote hain — foran badal dein.

title.en: Outdoor discharge pipe temperature sensor fault
title.ur: Compressor discharge pipe ka sensor theek nahi

meaning.en: The compressor discharge pipe thermistor reads open or short for 5 seconds.
meaning.ur: Compressor discharge pipe ka sensor 5 second tak open/short par raha hai.

causes.en: Discharge sensor connector loose or lead heat-damaged
causes.ur: Sensor connector dhila hai ya wire garmi se kharab ho gayi

causes.en: Thermistor open/short
causes.ur: Thermistor open/short hai

causes.en: Faulty outdoor PCB input
causes.ur: Outdoor PCB ka sensor input kharab hai

solutions.en: Reseat the discharge sensor plug and check the lead insulation
solutions.ur: Sensor plug dobara lagayein aur wire ki insulation check karein

solutions.en: Measure and replace the thermistor if open/short
solutions.ur: Thermistor measure karein, open/short ho to badlein

solutions.en: Check the outdoor PCB if the sensor is good
solutions.ur: Sensor theek ho to outdoor PCB check karein

notes.en: This sensor also backs discharge-temperature protection — a false reading can trip F97-type protection later.
notes.ur: Yeh sensor discharge-temperature protection ka bhi support karta hai — ghalat reading baad mein F97 jaisi protection trip kara sakti hai.

title.ur: Pool (water) sensor mein kharabi

meaning.en: A swimming-pool/heat-pump water sensor reported an abnormal value — air-to-water equipment only.
meaning.ur: Pool/heat-pump wale pani ka sensor ghalat reading de raha hai — sirf air-to-water units par.

causes.en: Water sensor open/short or not immersed correctly
causes.ur: Pani ka sensor open/short hai ya theek se andar nahi laga

causes.en: Wiring back to the controller damaged
causes.ur: Controller tak ki wire kharab hai

solutions.en: Check the sensor and its immersion point in the water tank/pool
solutions.ur: Sensor aur uski tank/pool mein placement check karein

solutions.en: Measure and replace the sensor if out of range
solutions.ur: Sensor ki reading lein, range se bahar ho to badlein

notes.en: Specialty air-to-water / pool-heat-pump code — NOT seen on standard PK wall splits. Official name only.
notes.ur: Yeh air-to-water / pool heat pump wali specialty code hai — standard PK wall splits mein nahi milti. Sirf official naam hai.

title.en: Outdoor heat exchanger temperature sensor 2 fault
title.ur: Outdoor coil ka doosra sensor theek nahi

meaning.en: The second outdoor coil sensor reads open or short for 5 seconds.
meaning.ur: Outdoor coil ka doosra sensor 5 second tak open/short par raha hai.

causes.en: Outdoor HX sensor 2 open/short or connector loose
causes.ur: Doosra outdoor coil sensor open/short hai ya connector dhila hai

causes.en: Lead wire damaged
causes.ur: Sensor ki wire kharab hai

causes.en: Faulty outdoor PCB input
causes.ur: Outdoor PCB ka sensor input kharab hai

solutions.en: Reseat the second outdoor coil sensor plug
solutions.ur: Doosre outdoor coil sensor ka plug dobara lagayein

solutions.en: Measure and replace the thermistor if open/short
solutions.ur: Thermistor measure karein, open/short ho to badlein

notes.en: Trip: open/short for 5 s. Only on models fitted with two outdoor coil sensors.
notes.ur: Trip: 5 second tak open/short. Sirf unhi models mein aati hain jin mein do outdoor coil sensors lage hote hain.

title.ur: Indoor aur outdoor ki voltage specification match nahi karti

meaning.en: The units exchanged their rated-voltage information and it does not match — wrong combination or wrong boards.
meaning.ur: Indoor aur outdoor ne apni rated voltage batai aur mili nahi — galat jodi ya galat PCB.

causes.en: Wrong models interconnected
causes.ur: Galat model joda hua hai

causes.en: Wrong indoor or outdoor PCB fitted
causes.ur: Indoor ya outdoor PCB galat lagaya hua hai

causes.en: Defective indoor or outdoor PCB
causes.ur: Indoor ya outdoor PCB kharab hai

solutions.en: Confirm indoor and outdoor model/voltage ratings match the combination table
solutions.ur: Indoor aur outdoor ki voltage/model rating combination table se match karein

solutions.en: Check the PCB part numbers against the model nameplate
solutions.ur: PCB ke part numbers unit ke nameplate se milayein

solutions.en: Replace the mismatched board with a technician
solutions.ur: Galat board technician se replace karwayein

notes.en: Manual title for it is 'Unspecified Voltage between Indoor and Outdoor'. Typical after a partial replacement (only one side swapped).
notes.ur: Manual mein iska title hai 'Unspecified Voltage between Indoor and Outdoor'. Aksar partial replacement (sirf ek side badli) ke baad aata hai.

title.en: Outdoor heat sink temperature sensor fault
title.ur: Outdoor heat sink (IPM ki thandak) ka sensor theek nahi

meaning.en: The outdoor heat-sink thermistor reads open or short for 2 seconds.
meaning.ur: Outdoor heat sink ka sensor 2 second tak open/short par raha hai.

causes.en: Heat sink sensor open/short or connector loose
causes.ur: Heat sink sensor open/short hai ya connector dhila hai

causes.en: Lead wire damaged near the IPM heatsink
causes.ur: IPM heatsink ke paas wire kharab ho gayi

causes.en: Faulty outdoor PCB input
causes.ur: Outdoor PCB ka sensor input kharab hai

solutions.en: Reseat the heat sink sensor plug and check the lead
solutions.ur: Sensor ka plug dobara lagayein aur wire check karein

solutions.en: Measure and replace the thermistor if open/short
solutions.ur: Thermistor measure karein, open/short ho to badlein

notes.en: Trip: open/short for 2 s. Protects the IPM — related family: F96 (IPM overheat).
notes.ur: Trip: 2 second tak open/short. Yeh IPM ko bachata hai — milta julta family: F96 (IPM overheat).

title.ur: Pani ke flow mein rukawat (air-to-water system)

meaning.en: Water flow/current in a hydronic (air-to-water) circuit is running the wrong way or too low — specialty equipment.
meaning.ur: Hydronic (pani wale) circuit mein pani ka flow ulti ya kam hai — khaas equipment par.

causes.en: Water pump not running or water flow too low
causes.ur: Pani ka pump nahi chal raha ya flow bohat kam hai

causes.en: Reversed flow / valve or strainer blocked
causes.ur: Flow ulti ho gayi ya valve/strainer block hai

solutions.en: Check the pump operation and water flow/strainer
solutions.ur: Pump ka kaam, flow aur strainer check karein

solutions.en: Verify piping direction and open isolation valves
solutions.ur: Piping ki direction check karein aur band valves khol dein

notes.en: Air-to-water / hydronic specialty code — not on standard PK wall splits. Official name only.
notes.ur: Air-to-water / hydronic specialty code — standard PK wall splits par nahi aati. Sirf official naam hai.

title.en: Outdoor gas pipe temperature sensor fault
title.ur: Outdoor gas pipe ka sensor theek nahi (heating)

meaning.en: The outdoor gas-pipe thermistor reads open or short for 5 seconds, mainly during heating.
meaning.ur: Outdoor gas pipe ka sensor 5 second tak open/short hai, zyada tar heating ke dauran.

causes.en: Gas pipe thermistor open/short or connector loose
causes.ur: Gas pipe thermistor open/short hai ya connector dhila hai

causes.en: Lead wire damaged at the flare nut/pipe clip
causes.ur: Flare nut ya pipe clip ke paas wire kharab ho gayi

causes.en: Faulty outdoor PCB input
causes.ur: Outdoor PCB ka sensor input kharab hai

solutions.en: Reseat the gas-pipe sensor plug and check the clip on the suction pipe
solutions.ur: Sensor ka plug dobara lagayein aur suction pipe pe clip check karein

solutions.en: Measure and replace the thermistor if open/short
solutions.ur: Thermistor measure karein, open/short ho to badlein

solutions.en: Check the outdoor PCB if the sensor is good
solutions.ur: Sensor theek ho to outdoor PCB check karein

notes.en: Manual flags it as a heating-protection sensor.
notes.ur: Manual ise heating-protection sensor batata hai.

title.en: Outdoor liquid pipe temperature sensor fault
title.ur: Outdoor liquid pipe ka sensor theek nahi (cooling)

meaning.en: The outdoor liquid-pipe thermistor reads open or short for 5 seconds, mainly during cooling.
meaning.ur: Outdoor liquid pipe ka sensor 5 second tak open/short hai, zyada tar cooling ke dauran.

causes.en: Liquid pipe thermistor open/short or connector loose
causes.ur: Liquid pipe thermistor open/short hai ya connector dhila hai

causes.en: Lead wire damaged at the pipe clip
causes.ur: Pipe clip ke paas wire kharab ho gayi

causes.en: Faulty outdoor PCB input
causes.ur: Outdoor PCB ka sensor input kharab hai

solutions.en: Reseat the liquid-pipe sensor plug and check the clip
solutions.ur: Sensor ka plug dobara lagayein aur clip check karein

solutions.en: Measure and replace the thermistor if open/short
solutions.ur: Thermistor measure karein, open/short ho to badlein

notes.en: Manual flags it as a cooling-protection sensor.
notes.ur: Manual ise cooling-protection sensor ke tor par batata hai.

title.ur: Indoor aur outdoor ka brand code match nahi kar raha

meaning.en: The indoor and outdoor units did not agree on their brand/capability codes, so they refuse to run together.
meaning.ur: Indoor aur outdoor ke brand/capability code aapas mein match nahi hue, is liye sath nahi chal rahe.

causes.en: Indoor and outdoor are not a matched pair (mixed units)
causes.ur: Indoor aur outdoor matched jodi nahi hain — mix karke lagaye gaye hain

causes.en: Wrong PCB fitted on one side
causes.ur: Ek side pe galat PCB laga hua hai

solutions.en: Verify both units are the same capability/series per the catalogue
solutions.ur: Dono units ki series/capability catalogue se verify karein

solutions.en: Replace the unit or board that carries the wrong brand code
solutions.ur: Galat brand code wale unit ya PCB ko badlein

notes.en: Problem stated as 'Brand code not match'; check location = check indoor and outdoor unit. Common after a mismatched replacement outdoor unit.
notes.ur: Problem ko 'Brand code not match' likha gaya hai; check location = indoor aur outdoor unit dono check karein. Ghalat replacement outdoor unit lagne ke baad aam hai.

title.ur: Multi mein kisi indoor unit ki kharabi

meaning.en: In a multi-split, one indoor unit reported a wiring/expansion-valve/sensor problem while others are waiting.
meaning.ur: Multi-split mein ek indoor unit ne wiring/expansion valve/sensor ki kharabi batai, baaki units wait par hain.

causes.en: Wrong piping/wiring or expansion-valve (EEV) fault
causes.ur: Piping/wiring galat hai ya expansion valve (EEV) kharab hai

causes.en: Indoor heat exchanger sensor open circuit
causes.ur: Indoor heat exchanger sensor open circuit hai

causes.en: Faulty lead wire/connector at the expansion valve
causes.ur: Expansion valve ki lead wire/connector kharab hai

solutions.en: Check the indoor/outdoor connection wire and each branch pipe
solutions.ur: Connection wire aur har branch pipe check karein

solutions.en: Test the indoor heat exchanger sensor and reseat its connector
solutions.ur: Indoor HX sensor check karein aur connector dobara lagayein

solutions.en: Check the expansion valve and its lead wire
solutions.ur: Expansion valve aur uski wire check karein

notes.en: Trips 3 times within 40 minutes. Related: when a standby indoor unit freezes, that unit shows F17 and the others show H39 (service manual remark).
notes.ur: 40 minute mein 3 baar trip karta hai. Related: jab koi standby indoor unit jam jaye to us par F17 aata hai aur baqi units H39 dikhati hain (service manual ka note).

title.ur: Wiring ya piping connection theek nahi

meaning.en: The indoor/outdoor wiring or piping was flagged as incorrectly connected.
meaning.ur: Indoor/outdoor ki wiring ya piping galat lagayi gayi hai — aise detect hua.

causes.en: Wrong wiring connection between indoor and outdoor
causes.ur: Indoor aur outdoor ke beech wiring galat hai

causes.en: Piping/connection pipe mistake, expansion valve problem
causes.ur: Piping/connection pipe mein ghalti hai ya expansion valve theek nahi

solutions.en: Re-verify the wiring diagram and terminal mapping
solutions.ur: Wiring diagram aur terminal mapping dobara check karein

solutions.en: Check pipe connections and the expansion valve
solutions.ur: Pipe connections aur expansion valve check karein

notes.en: Also present in the official NA operating manual list (2 official/manual sources agree).
notes.ur: Yeh official NA operating manual ki list mein bhi maujood hai (2 official/manual sources agree karte hain).

title.ur: Ventilation (ducted) fan atka hua hai

meaning.en: The fresh-air/ventilation fan motor is locked or its feedback is abnormal.
meaning.ur: Fresh-air/ventilation ka fan atka hua hai ya uska feedback theek nahi aa raha.

causes.en: Ventilation fan blocked or motor defective
causes.ur: Ventilation fan mein rukawat hai ya motor kharab hai

causes.en: Indoor PCB (fan drive) faulty
causes.ur: Indoor PCB ka fan drive hissa kharab hai

solutions.en: Power off and check the ventilation fan for blockage
solutions.ur: Power band karke ventilation fan mein rukawat check karein

solutions.en: Have the fan motor and indoor PCB tested
solutions.ur: Fan motor aur indoor PCB test karwayein

source.title: Panasonic air conditioner error codes compile (npcdn mirror)

notes.en: Compile gives trip '7 times continuously' and verify = indoor PCB / ventilation motor. Ventilation-fresh-air units only — not standard PK wall splits.
notes.ur: Compile mein trip '7 times continuously' likha hai aur verify = indoor PCB / ventilation motor. Sirf ventilation/fresh-air units par hota hai — standard PK wall splits par nahi.

title.en: Ventilation fan motor locked / nozzle lock
title.ur: Ventilation fan ya nozzle lock

meaning.en: Official table repeats 'ventilation fan motor locked'; older Panasonic tables call H51 a nozzle-lock fault.
meaning.ur: Official table par ventilation fan locked likha hai; purani tables mein H51 nozzle lock ka fault hai.

causes.en: Ventilation fan or damper/nozzle mechanism jammed
causes.ur: Ventilation fan ya damper/nozzle mechanism atka hua hai

causes.en: Indoor PCB drive faulty
causes.ur: Indoor PCB ka drive kharab hai

solutions.en: Check the fan/damper mechanism for jamming
solutions.ur: Fan/damper mechanism mein atawal check karein

solutions.en: Have the indoor PCB drive tested
solutions.ur: Indoor PCB ka drive test karwayein

notes.en: SOURCE CONFLICT: official page says 'Ventilation fan motor locked' (same as H50); the legacy compile says 'Nozzle lock abnormality, 2 times continuously, verify = nozzle'. Kept with the official name; verify on model.
notes.ur: SOURCE CONFLICT: official page par 'Ventilation fan motor locked' likha hai (H50 jaisa); purani compile mein 'Nozzle lock abnormality, 2 times continuously, verify = nozzle' hai. Official naam hi rakha hai; apne model par verify karein.

title.ur: Left/right limit switch theek se set nahi

meaning.en: The left/right airflow louver limit-switch position is wrong or its fixing is loose.
meaning.ur: Left/right airflow louver ka limit switch position galat hai ya uski fixing dhili hai.

causes.en: Limit switch loose, misaligned or defective
causes.ur: Limit switch dhila, hil gaya ya kharab hai

causes.en: Louver/motor mechanism jammed so the switch never reaches its position
causes.ur: Louver/motor mechanism atka hua hai is liye switch apni position tak nahi jata

solutions.en: Power off and re-align/fix the limit switch
solutions.ur: Power band karke limit switch ko theek se align/kas ke lagayein

solutions.en: Check the louver motor and linkage for jamming
solutions.ur: Louver motor aur linkage mein atawal check karein

notes.en: Older table words it as 'Limit switch abnormality, verify = indoor PCB'. Name confirmed by the official page; cause list inferred.
notes.ur: Purani table mein yeh 'Limit switch abnormality, verify = indoor PCB' ke tor par likha hai. Naam official page se confirm hua; cause list andaze se banayi gayi hai.

title.ur: Indoor gas/patrol sensor theek nahi

meaning.en: The indoor gas / patrol (human-detection) sensor feedback is stuck at 0 V or 5 V while the patrol function is ON.
meaning.ur: Patrol function on hone par indoor gas/patrol sensor ki feedback 0 V ya 5 V par atak gayi hai.

causes.en: Patrol/gas sensor connector loose or sensor failed
causes.ur: Patrol/gas sensor ka connector dhila hai ya sensor kharab hai

causes.en: Indoor PCB fault
causes.ur: Indoor PCB kharab hai

solutions.en: Turn the patrol function off, power cycle and confirm the code clears
solutions.ur: Patrol function band karke power cycle karein, code clear ho jaye to theek

solutions.en: Reseat/replace the sensor if the code returns
solutions.ur: Code wapas aaye to sensor dobara lagayein ya badlein

notes.en: Trip: feedback 0 V or 5 V continuous for 6 h, shown only while Patrol is ON. NAME CONFLICT inside the manual: table says 'Indoor gas sensor abnormality', §16.4.17 is titled 'Patrol Sensor Abnormality'.
notes.ur: Trip: feedback 6 ghante tak lagatar 0 V ya 5 V rahe, aur sirf Patrol ON hone par dikhai de. Manual ke andar NAME CONFLICT hai: table mein 'Indoor gas sensor abnormality' hai, jabke §16.4.17 ka title 'Patrol Sensor Abnormality' hai.

title.ur: Eco sensor theek kaam nahi kar raha

meaning.en: The eco/occupancy sensor reported an abnormal value.
meaning.ur: Eco/occupancy sensor ne ghalat reading batai hai.

causes.en: Eco sensor faulty or its connector loose
causes.ur: Eco sensor kharab hai ya uska connector dhila hai

causes.en: Indoor PCB input faulty
causes.ur: Indoor PCB ka input kharab hai

solutions.en: Reseat the eco sensor connector and check for dust blocking the sensor
solutions.ur: Sensor ka connector dobara lagayein aur sensor pe dhansi gandagi hatayein

solutions.en: Replace the sensor if the reading stays abnormal
solutions.ur: Reading abnormal rahe to sensor badlein

source.title: Panasonic RE9SKUA/RE12SKUA operating manual (diagnostic display list)

notes.en: Present in the official page and the official NA operating manual (2 official sources); no published cause list.
notes.ur: Yeh official page aur official NA operating manual dono mein maujood hai (2 official sources); koi cause list shaya nahi hui.

title.ur: Outdoor high pressure sensor theek nahi

meaning.en: The outdoor high-pressure sensor line reads open circuit while the compressor is stopped.
meaning.ur: Compressor band honepara outdoor high pressure sensor open circuit par raha hai.

causes.en: High-pressure sensor open/short or connector not seated
causes.ur: High pressure sensor open/short hai ya connector nahi laga

causes.en: Lead wire/connector damaged
causes.ur: Wire ya connector kharab hai

causes.en: Outdoor PCB input faulty
causes.ur: Outdoor PCB ka input kharab hai

solutions.en: Power off, check the high-pressure sensor plug and wiring
solutions.ur: Power band karke high pressure sensor ka plug aur wire check karein

solutions.en: Test/replace the sensor and re-check
solutions.ur: Sensor test karke badlein aur dobara check karein

notes.en: Trip: open circuit during compressor stop, detected for 1 minute. Related protection: F94/F95 high pressure.
notes.ur: Trip: compressor band hone ke doran open circuit, 1 minute tak pakda jata hai. Related protection: F94/F95 high pressure.

title.ur: nanoe feature fault hai

meaning.en: The nanoe air-purification generator reported a fault.
meaning.ur: nanoe (air purification) generator ne fault bataya hai.

causes.en: nanoe module/generator faulty
causes.ur: nanoe module generator kharab hai

causes.en: Indoor PCB drive circuit for nanoe faulty
causes.ur: Indoor PCB ka nanoe drive circuit kharab hai

solutions.en: Switch nanoe off, power cycle the unit and check whether the code clears
solutions.ur: nanoe band karke power cycle karein, code clear ho jaye to theek

solutions.en: Have the nanoe module and indoor PCB checked if it returns
solutions.ur: Code wapas aaye to nanoe module aur indoor PCB check karwayein

notes.en: Official name only — no cause list published. nanoe-equipped models only.
notes.ur: Sirf official naam hai — koi cause list shaya nahi hui. Sirf nanoe-equipped models par lagu hoti hai.

title.ur: Light sensor theek nahi

meaning.en: The ambient light sensor (used for panel/display behaviour) reported an abnormal value.
meaning.ur: Light sensor ne ghalat reading batai hai.

causes.en: Light sensor blocked, dirty or failed
causes.ur: Light sensor block/dirty hai ya kharab ho gaya

causes.en: Indoor PCB input faulty
causes.ur: Indoor PCB ka input kharab hai

solutions.en: Clean the sensor window and remove any cover blocking it
solutions.ur: Sensor ki window saaf karein aur upar pada cover hatayein

solutions.en: Replace the sensor if the code persists
solutions.ur: Code rahe to sensor badlein

source.title: Panasonic RE9SKUA/RE12SKUA operating manual (diagnostic display list)

notes.en: Official page + official NA manual agree; no published cause list.
notes.ur: Official page aur official NA manual dono agree karte hain; koi cause list shaya nahi hui.

title.en: DC cooling fan inside control board abnormality
title.ur: Control board ke andar ka DC cooling fan theek nahi

meaning.en: The small DC fan that cools the control box is locked or not reporting speed.
meaning.ur: Control box ko thanda karne wala chhota DC fan atka hua hai ya speed nahi bata raha.

causes.en: Control-board cooling fan blocked or failed
causes.ur: Control board ka fan block hai ya kharab ho gaya

causes.en: Fan connector/faulty drive on the board
causes.ur: Fan ka connector ya board ka drive kharab hai

solutions.en: Power off and clean the control-box fan and its filter
solutions.ur: Power band karke control box ka fan aur filter saaf karein

solutions.en: Replace the fan or have the board checked if it does not spin
solutions.ur: Fan na ghume to fan badlein ya board check karwayein

notes.en: Official name only — cause/solution inferred from the name. Higher ambient (PK summers) makes control-box cooling failures more likely.
notes.ur: Sirf official naam hai — cause/solution naam se hi andaza lagaya gaya hai. Zyada ambient (PK ki garmi) mein control-box cooling kharab hone ka khatra barh jata hai.

title.ur: Tank ka temperature sensor theek nahi

meaning.en: The water-tank temperature sensor (air-to-water/hydronic equipment) reported an abnormal value.
meaning.ur: Pani ke tank ka sensor ghalat reading de raha hai — air-to-water equipment par.

causes.en: Tank sensor open/short or connector loose
causes.ur: Tank sensor open/short hai ya connector dhila hai

causes.en: Wiring to the controller damaged
causes.ur: Controller tak ki wire kharab hai

solutions.en: Check the tank sensor plug and immersion position
solutions.ur: Tank sensor ka plug aur uski placement check karein

solutions.en: Measure and replace the sensor if out of range
solutions.ur: Sensor ki reading lein, range se bahar ho to badlein

notes.en: Specialty air-to-water / tank equipment — not on standard PK wall splits. Official name only.
notes.ur: Yeh air-to-water / tank equipment wali specialty code hai — standard PK wall splits par nahi milti. Sirf official naam hai.

title.ur: Wi-Fi module mein write error

meaning.en: The built-in Wi-Fi module failed a firmware/settings write operation.
meaning.ur: Wi-Fi module ki firmware/settings write operation fail ho gayi.

causes.en: Wi-Fi module memory/write failure
causes.ur: Wi-Fi module ka memory/write hissa fail ho gaya

causes.en: Interrupted firmware update or bad module supply
causes.ur: Firmware update beech mein ruk gayi ya module ko supply theek nahi

solutions.en: Retry the Wi-Fi module update/registration from the app
solutions.ur: App se Wi-Fi module ka update/registration dobara karein

solutions.en: Power cycle and re-pair; replace the module if it still fails
solutions.ur: Power cycle karke dobara pair karein, phir bhi fail ho to module badlein

notes.en: Wi-Fi-equipped models only. Official name only — cause/solution inferred from the name.
notes.ur: Sirf Wi-Fi-equipped models. Sirf official naam — cause/solution naam se hi andaza lagaya gaya.

title.en: Communication fault: indoor unit and wireless LAN module
title.ur: Indoor aur Wi-Fi module ka communication nahi

meaning.en: The indoor unit cannot talk to its wireless LAN module.
meaning.ur: Indoor unit apne Wi-Fi module se baat nahi kar pa rahi.

causes.en: Module connector loose or not fitted properly
causes.ur: Module ka connector dhila hai ya theek se nahi laga

causes.en: Faulty Wi-Fi module or indoor PCB interface
causes.ur: Wi-Fi module kharab hai ya indoor PCB ka interface theek nahi

solutions.en: Power off and reseat the Wi-Fi module connector
solutions.ur: Power band karke Wi-Fi module ka connector dobara lagayein

solutions.en: Re-pair the module in the Comfort Cloud app; replace it if it still fails
solutions.ur: Comfort Cloud app mein module dobara pair karein, phir fail ho to module badlein

notes.en: Wi-Fi-equipped models only. Official name only — cause/solution inferred from the name.
notes.ur: Yeh sirf Wi-Fi-equipped models par aata hai. Official naam hi hai — cause/solution naam se hi lagaya gaya hai.

title.ur: Outdoor ka fan atka hua hai / chal nahi raha

meaning.en: The outdoor fan speed feedback is outside the normal range — fan jammed or feedback wiring broken.
meaning.ur: Outdoor fan ki speed normal range se bahar hai — fan atka hai ya feedback wire tooti hui hai.

causes.en: Outdoor fan blocked (dirt/debris) or motor winding short/open
causes.ur: Outdoor fan mein gandagi/rukawat hai ya motor winding short/open hai

causes.en: Fan lead wire broken or connector not contacting
causes.ur: Fan ki wire tooti hui hai ya connector contact nahi kar raha

causes.en: Hall IC failure or faulty outdoor PCB
causes.ur: Hall IC kharab hai ya outdoor PCB fault hai

solutions.en: Power off, clear the condenser and spin the outdoor fan by hand
solutions.ur: Power band karke condenser saaf karein aur haath se outdoor fan ghumayein

solutions.en: Check the fan connector and motor lead continuity
solutions.ur: Fan ka connector aur motor leads ki continuity check karein

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor fan motor if jammed or the winding is open
solutions.ur: Fan motor atka ho ya winding open ho to motor badlein

notes.en: Trip: 2 occurrences within 30 minutes (compile wording: '2 times within 30 minutes').
notes.ur: Trip: 30 minute ke andar 2 baar (compile ka lafz: '2 times within 30 minutes').

title.ur: Heating mein indoor coil ki high pressure protection

meaning.en: During heating the indoor pipe went above 60 °C, so the unit protects itself against high pressure.
meaning.ur: Heating ke dauran indoor pipe 60 °C se upar chala gaya, is liye unit high pressure se protect karne ke liye ruk gayi.

causes.en: Clogged indoor air filter / dirty heat exchanger
causes.ur: Indoor ka filter ganda hai ya heat exchanger par jama dhans

causes.en: Air short circuit (blocked return air, closed vents)
causes.ur: Air short circuit — return air block hai ya vents band hain

causes.en: Faulty indoor pipe sensor or indoor PCB misreading
causes.ur: Indoor pipe sensor kharab hai ya indoor PCB ghalat reading le raha hai

solutions.en: Clean or replace the indoor filter and wash the indoor coil
solutions.ur: Indoor filter saaf/badlein aur indoor coil wash karein

solutions.en: Remove anything blocking return/supply airflow
solutions.ur: Return/supply airflow mein rukawat hatayein

solutions.en: Check the indoor pipe sensor if the code returns after cleaning
solutions.ur: Safai ke baad code aaye to indoor pipe sensor check karein

notes.en: Service manual: 'Error code will not display (no Timer LED blinking) but store in EEPROM' — you can still read it with the CHECK method.
notes.ur: Service manual ke mutabiq: 'Error code display par nahi aata (Timer LED blink nahi karta) lekin EEPROM mein save hota hai' — ise CHECK method se phir bhi parha ja sakta hai.

codes.blinkPattern: Timer LED does not blink — fault is stored in EEPROM only

title.ur: Cooling mein indoor coil jam raha hai (freeze protection)

meaning.en: The indoor pipe dropped below 2 °C, so freeze-prevention control kicked in to stop the coil icing up.
meaning.ur: Indoor pipe 2 °C se neeche chala gaya, is liye coil ko jamne se bachane ke liye freeze protection chalu ho gayi.

causes.en: Clogged indoor air filter or dirty heat exchanger
causes.ur: Indoor filter ganda hai ya heat exchanger par jama dhans

causes.en: Air short circuit / very low airflow
causes.ur: Air short circuit hai ya hawa ka flow bohat kam hai

causes.en: Faulty indoor pipe sensor or indoor PCB
causes.ur: Indoor pipe sensor kharab hai ya indoor PCB fault hai

solutions.en: Clean or replace the indoor filter and wash the coil
solutions.ur: Indoor filter saaf/badlein aur coil wash karein

solutions.en: Check fan speed and clear anything blocking airflow
solutions.ur: Fan ki speed check karein aur airflow mein rukawat hatayein

solutions.en: Verify the indoor pipe sensor after cleaning
solutions.ur: Safai ke baad indoor pipe sensor verify karein

notes.en: Trip: freeze-prevention control runs when indoor pipe < 2 °C. Also stated in the official NA operating manual as a 'clean filter' warning code.
notes.ur: Trip: indoor pipe 2 °C se neeche ho to freeze-prevention control chalne lagta hai. Official NA operating manual mein ise 'clean filter' warning code bhi kaha gaya hai.

codes.blinkPattern: Timer LED does not blink — fault is stored in EEPROM only

title.ur: 4-way valve (heat/cool changeover) theek se switch nahi kar raha

meaning.en: The heat/cool changeover valve did not switch to the expected position.
meaning.ur: Heat aur cool badalne wala 4-way valve expected position par nahi gaya.

causes.en: 4-way valve coil/RV solenoid or its connector faulty
causes.ur: 4-way valve ka coil/RV solenoid ya uska connector kharab hai

causes.en: Valve stuck (installed on a system that never heats, valves can seize)
causes.ur: Valve atak gaya — heating na karne wali unit mein valve jam ho sakta hai

causes.en: Outdoor PCB drive or lead wire problem
causes.ur: Outdoor PCB ka drive ya lead wire mein masla hai

solutions.en: Check the 4-way valve connector and coil resistance
solutions.ur: 4-way valve ka connector aur coil ki resistance check karein

solutions.en: Tap/energise the valve once (or reverse heat/cool) and watch if it shifts
solutions.ur: Valve ko ek dafa energise/switch karke dekhein ke woh khulta hai ya nahi

solutions.en: Replace the valve/RV coil if it does not shift (technician job)
solutions.ur: Valve na khule to valve/RV coil badlein (technician ka kaam)

notes.en: Trip: 4 occurrences within 30 minutes (manual also cites indoor pipe <10 °C in heating / >45 °C in cooling). South-Indian/SE-Asian content farms wrongly call F11 an indoor-fan fault — that is quarantined.
notes.ur: Trip: 30 minute mein 4 baar (manual heating mein indoor pipe <10 °C aur cooling mein >45 °C bhi deta hai). South-Indian/SE-Asian content farms F11 ko ghalat taur par indoor-fan fault kehte hain — usay quarantine kiya gaya hai.

title.ur: Total running current ki protection trip

meaning.en: The unit's total running current went over the protection limit.
meaning.ur: Unit ka total current protection limit se upar chala gaya.

causes.en: Compressor drawing high current (winding short or seizure)
causes.ur: Compressor zyada current le raha hai — winding short ya jam

causes.en: Weak supply voltage / overloaded mains (common in PK load-shedding areas)
causes.ur: Supply voltage kamzor hai ya load zyada hai (PK mein aam)

causes.en: Outdoor PCB current-sense or power stage faulty
causes.ur: Outdoor PCB ka current-sense ya power stage kharab hai

solutions.en: Measure running amps against the nameplate rating
solutions.ur: Chalte waqt ke ampere nameplate rating se compare karein

solutions.en: Check supply voltage and the outdoor unit's wiring/terminals
solutions.ur: Supply voltage aur outdoor ki wiring/terminals check karein

solutions.en: Have the outdoor PCB/compressor tested if amps stay high
solutions.ur: Ampere zyada rahe to outdoor PCB/compressor test karwayein

notes.en: Official name only — no cause list published. Overlaps in meaning with F98 (total running current) and F99 (DC peak); treat as an electrical stop-pro fault.
notes.ur: Sirf official naam hai — cause list shaya nahi hui. Matlab F98 (total running current) aur F99 (DC peak) se milta hai; ise electrical stop-pro fault samajh lein.

title.ur: Multi mein koi standby indoor unit jam raha hai

meaning.en: In a multi-split, a non-running (standby) indoor unit is freezing up.
meaning.ur: Multi-split mein jo indoor unit band chal rahi thi woh jam/ freeze ho rahi hai.

causes.en: Wrong wiring connection between branch pipes
causes.ur: Branch pipes ki wiring/connection galat hai

causes.en: Faulty sensor or faulty expansion valve
causes.ur: Sensor kharab hai ya expansion valve theek nahi

causes.en: Refrigerant leakage at the branch
causes.ur: Branch par refrigerant leakage hai

solutions.en: Check indoor/outdoor connection wire and each branch pipe
solutions.ur: Connection wire aur har branch pipe check karein

solutions.en: Test the indoor heat exchanger sensor and its connector
solutions.ur: Indoor HX sensor aur connector test karein

solutions.en: Check the expansion valve operation and gas charge
solutions.ur: Expansion valve ka kaam aur gas charge check karein

notes.en: Trip: intake-to-pipe difference > 10 °C or pipe < -1.0 °C, 3 times within 40 min. Multi only — the freezing unit shows F17 and the other indoor units show H39.
notes.ur: Trip: intake aur pipe ka farq 10 °C se zyada ho ya pipe -1.0 °C se kam, 40 minute mein 3 baar. Sirf multi mein — jo unit jam rahi hai us par F17 aur baqi indoor units par H39 aata hai.

title.ur: Dry (dehumidify) circuit block hai

meaning.en: The dry-mode refrigerant circuit reported a blocked condition.
meaning.ur: Dry mode ka circuit block bata raha hai.

causes.en: Blockage/moisture in the refrigerant circuit (capillary/EEV)
causes.ur: Refrigerant circuit mein blockage ya moisture (capillary/EEV)

causes.en: Closed service valve or kinked pipe
causes.ur: Service valve band hai ya pipe mura hua hai

solutions.en: Verify all service valves are fully open and pipes are not kinked
solutions.ur: Saare service valves poore khule hain aur pipe mura nahi hai — check karein

solutions.en: Have the circuit flushed/vacuumed by a technician
solutions.ur: Technician se circuit flush/vacuum karwayein

notes.en: Official name only — no cause list published.
notes.ur: Sirf official naam hai — koi cause list shaya nahi hui.

title.ur: Control box garam ho gaya

meaning.en: The temperature inside the control box passed the overheat limit.
meaning.ur: Control box ka temperature limit se upar chala gaya.

causes.en: Poor ventilation around the outdoor control box / blocked louvers
causes.ur: Control box ke aas paas hawa ka flow roka hua hai

causes.en: High ambient and long continuous running
causes.ur: Ambient bohat zyada hai aur unit lambi der se chal rahi hai

causes.en: Failing cooling fan or heat-damaged components
causes.ur: Cooling fan kharab hai ya components garmi se kharab ho gaye

solutions.en: Power off and let the unit cool, then clear the control-box airflow path
solutions.ur: Power band karke unit ko thanda hone dein, phir control box ki hawa ka rasta saaf karein

solutions.en: Check for sun-loaded/blocked outdoor installation and improve shading
solutions.ur: Outdoor unit dhoop mein to nahi — shade karke hawa ka flow behtar karein

solutions.en: Have the board's cooling fan and components checked
solutions.ur: Board ke cooling fan aur components check karwayein

notes.en: Official name only — cause/solution inferred. Relevant to PK rooftop/balcony units in 45 °C+ ambient.
notes.ur: Sirf official naam hai — cause/solution andaze se liya gaya. PK ke rooftop/balcony units ke liye yeh code relevant hai jo 45 °C+ ambient mein chalte hain.

title.ur: Power factor correction (PFC) circuit ki protection

meaning.en: The outdoor PFC stage saw an abnormal high DC bus voltage and shut the unit down.
meaning.ur: Outdoor PFC stage ne DC bus par abnormal high voltage dekhi aur unit band kar di.

causes.en: DC voltage peak from a mains supply surge
causes.ur: Supply surge se DC voltage peak aa gayi

causes.en: Non-uniform compressor windings stressing the DC bus
causes.ur: Compressor ki winding theek nahi, is se DC bus par load pada

causes.en: Faulty outdoor PCB
causes.ur: Outdoor PCB kharab hai

solutions.en: Check the incoming supply voltage and fit a stabiliser/surge protection
solutions.ur: Supply voltage check karein aur stabiliser/surge protection lagwayein

solutions.en: Have the outdoor PCB and compressor windings tested
solutions.ur: Outdoor PCB aur compressor winding test karwayein

solutions.en: After a surge event, power off for 10 minutes and retry
solutions.ur: Surge ke baad 10 minute power off rakh ke phir start karein

notes.en: Trip: 4 occurrences within 10 minutes; check location = PFC voltage / outdoor PCB. Official page adds an alternate wording: '/system and compressor microcomputer communication error'.
notes.ur: Trip: 10 minute mein 4 baar; check location = PFC voltage / outdoor PCB. Official page par ek alt lafz bhi hai: '/system and compressor microcomputer communication error'.

title.ur: Refrigerant cycle theek nahi — gas kam hai

meaning.en: The unit cannot move enough heat through the refrigerant circuit — typically low gas or a closed valve.
meaning.ur: Refrigerant circuit se heat theek tarah nahi ban rahi — aam tor par gas kam hai ya valve band hai.

causes.en: Refrigerant shortage from a leak
causes.ur: Leakage ki wajah se refrigerant kam hai

causes.en: 3-way/service valve left closed
causes.ur: 3-way/service valve band reh gaya

causes.en: Poor compressor compression performance
causes.ur: Compressor ki compression kamzor hai

causes.en: False reading from a faulty indoor intake/pipe sensor
causes.ur: Indoor intake/pipe sensor kharab hone se ghalat reading aa rahi hai

solutions.en: Check that all service valves are fully opened (back-seat them)
solutions.ur: Sab service valves poore khule hain — check karein

solutions.en: Leak-test the circuit, repair the leak and recharge to spec
solutions.ur: Circuit ki leak test karein, leak theek karke specification ke mutabiq gas bharwayein

solutions.en: Verify the indoor intake and pipe sensors
solutions.ur: Indoor intake aur pipe sensors verify karein

notes.en: Trip: 2 occurrences within 20 minutes; multi models use current-vs-frequency and pipe-vs-intake delta for gas-shortage detection. Refrigerant work = certified technician only.
notes.ur: Trip: 20 minute mein 2 baar; multi models gas kam hone ki nishandahi ke liye current-vs-frequency aur pipe-vs-intake delta use karte hain. Refrigerant ka kaam sirf certified technician kare.

title.ur: Compressor sahi speed par ghoom nahi raha

meaning.en: The position-detection circuit says the compressor is not rotating as commanded.
meaning.ur: Position detection circuit bata raha hai ke compressor hukm ke mutabiq nahi ghoom raha.

causes.en: Compressor terminal disconnected or loose
causes.ur: Compressor ke terminal khule/dhile hain

causes.en: Outdoor PCB (position detection/drive) malfunction
causes.ur: Outdoor PCB ka position detection/drive kharab hai

causes.en: Compressor rotor locked
causes.ur: Compressor ka rotor atka hua hai

solutions.en: Power off for 10 minutes, then check the compressor terminals
solutions.ur: 10 minute power off rakh ke compressor ke terminals check karein

solutions.en: Check the outdoor PCB drive stage and connector
solutions.ur: Outdoor PCB ka drive stage aur connector check karein

solutions.en: Have the compressor tested for lock/RCD before replacing parts
solutions.ur: Part badalne se pehle compressor ka lock/test karwayein

notes.en: Trip: 4 occurrences within 20 minutes. Check location: power transistor module or compressor lock.
notes.ur: Trip: 20 minute mein 4 baar. Jagah check karein: power transistor module ya compressor ka lock.

title.ur: Discharge pressure bohat zyada ho gaya

meaning.en: Discharge pressure went above the allowed overshoot limit, so the unit stopped the compressor.
meaning.ur: Discharge pressure allowed limit se upar chala gaya, is liye compressor band kar diya.

causes.en: Non-condensables or overcharge in the system
causes.ur: System mein air/gas zyada hai (overcharge ya air)

causes.en: Blocked condenser or failed outdoor fan
causes.ur: Condenser block hai ya outdoor fan nahi chal raha

causes.en: Faulty high-pressure sensor reading
causes.ur: High pressure sensor ghalat reading de raha hai

solutions.en: Clean the condenser and confirm the outdoor fan runs
solutions.ur: Condenser saaf karein aur outdoor fan chal raha hai — check karein

solutions.en: Check gas charge and purge non-condensables if the system was opened
solutions.ur: System khula tha to gas charge aur air check karein

solutions.en: Have the high-pressure sensor verified
solutions.ur: High pressure sensor verify karwayein

notes.en: Trip: 4 occurrences within 30 minutes; check location = refrigeration system. Official page wording: 'Compressor discharge pressure protection'; NA manual: 'discharge pressure overshoot protection'.
notes.ur: Trip: 30 minute mein 4 baar; check location = refrigeration system. Official page ka lafz: 'Compressor discharge pressure protection'; NA manual: 'discharge pressure overshoot protection'.

title.ur: Cooling mein outdoor side ka pressure bohat zyada

meaning.en: The outdoor coil temperature reached 61 °C during cooling — the high-pressure side is overheating.
meaning.ur: Cooling ke dauran outdoor coil ka temperature 61 °C tak chala gaya — high pressure side garam ho raha hai.

causes.en: Hot discharge air short-circuited back into the condenser
causes.ur: Outdoor ki nikli hui garam hawa wapas condenser mein ja rahi hai

causes.en: Outdoor fan motor defective or condenser blocked/dirty
causes.ur: Outdoor fan kharab hai ya condenser ganda/block hai

causes.en: Faulty outdoor pipe sensor or outdoor PCB
causes.ur: Outdoor pipe sensor kharab hai ya outdoor PCB fault hai

solutions.en: Clean the condenser and clear the outdoor unit's airflow space
solutions.ur: Condenser saaf karein aur outdoor ke aas paas ka rasta khali karein

solutions.en: Confirm the outdoor fan runs at full speed
solutions.ur: Outdoor fan poori speed se chal raha hai — check karein

solutions.en: Check the outdoor pipe sensor reading and the gas charge
solutions.ur: Outdoor pipe sensor ki reading aur gas charge check karein

notes.en: Trip: 4 occurrences within 20 minutes; detection = outdoor pipe sensor at 61 °C. Very common in PK peak summer when the condenser is clogged or undersized shading is missing.
notes.ur: Trip: 20 minute mein 4 baar; detection = outdoor pipe sensor 61 °C par. PK ki peak garmi mein yeh bohat aam hai jab condenser ganda ho ya shading na ho.

title.ur: IPM (power module) overheat ho gaya

meaning.en: The IPM temperature reached 100 °C, so the drive shut down.
meaning.ur: IPM ka temperature 100 °C tak gaya, is liye drive band ho gayi.

causes.en: Hot discharge air short-circuiting over the outdoor board
causes.ur: Garam hawa board par wapas ja rahi hai (short circuit)

causes.en: Outdoor fan motor defective
causes.ur: Outdoor fan kharab hai

causes.en: Internal IPM fault or faulty IPM temperature sensor
causes.ur: IPM ke andar fault hai ya IPM ka temperature sensor kharab hai

causes.en: Compressor OL connector poor contact (multi models)
causes.ur: Compressor OL ka connector loose hai (multi models)

solutions.en: Clean the outdoor unit and make sure nothing blocks the board cooling
solutions.ur: Outdoor saaf karein aur board ki hawa ka rasta block na ho — check karein

solutions.en: Confirm the outdoor fan runs and the capacitor is good
solutions.ur: Outdoor fan chal raha hai aur capacitor theek hai — confirm karein

solutions.en: Have the IPM, its temperature sensor and the compressor OL checked
solutions.ur: IPM, uska temperature sensor aur compressor OL check karwayein

notes.en: Trip: 4 occurrences within 30 minutes; IPM sensor at 100 °C (multi also: compressor OL or heat sink 90 °C).
notes.ur: Trip: 30 minute mein 4 baar; IPM sensor 100 °C par (multi mein: compressor OL ya heat sink 90 °C).

title.ur: Compressor overheat ho gaya (112 °C)

meaning.en: The compressor body temperature hit 112 °C and the unit shut the compressor down.
meaning.ur: Compressor ka temperature 112 °C tak gaya, is liye unit ne compressor band kar diya.

causes.en: Refrigerant shortage from a leak
causes.ur: Leakage ki wajah se refrigerant kam hai

causes.en: 2/3-way service valve left closed
causes.ur: 2/3-way service valve band reh gaya

causes.en: Faulty compressor tank (body) temperature sensor
causes.ur: Compressor body ka temperature sensor kharab hai

solutions.en: Open all service valves fully and check for leaks
solutions.ur: Saare service valves poore kholein aur leak check karein

solutions.en: Leak-test, repair and recharge the system to spec
solutions.ur: Leak test karke repair aur specification ke mutabiq gas bharwayein

solutions.en: Measure/replace the compressor temperature sensor
solutions.ur: Compressor ka temperature sensor measure/badlein

notes.en: Trip: 3 occurrences within 30 minutes (compile says 4 within 10 min — thresholds vary by model). Detection: compressor tank sensor at 112 °C.
notes.ur: Trip: 30 minute mein 3 baar (compile mein 10 minute mein 4 likha hai — threshold model se badalta hai). Detection: compressor tank sensor 112 °C par.

title.ur: Unit ka total current 16.8 A se upar chala gaya

meaning.en: Input current reached 16.8 A while the compressor was running, so the unit cut out.
meaning.ur: Compressor chalte waqt input current 16.8 A tak barh gayi, is liye unit ne cut kar di.

causes.en: Compressor failure drawing high current
causes.ur: Compressor kharab ho kar zyada current le raha hai

causes.en: Defective outdoor unit PCB
causes.ur: Outdoor unit PCB kharab hai

causes.en: Defective inverter main-circuit electrolytic capacitor
causes.ur: Inverter ke main circuit ka electrolytic capacitor kharab hai

causes.en: Excess refrigerant charge
causes.ur: Refrigerant zyada bhar diya gaya hai

solutions.en: Clamp-meter the running amps and compare with the nameplate
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se chalte hue ampere lein aur nameplate se compare karein

solutions.en: Check the run capacitor/PCB capacitors and outdoor PCB
solutions.ur: Run capacitor/PCB ke capacitors aur outdoor PCB check karein

solutions.en: Verify the gas charge is not over spec
solutions.ur: Gas charge specification se zyada na ho — verify karein

notes.en: Trip: 3 occurrences within 20 minutes; detection = 16.8 A input current via CT. Electrical hazard class — do not keep resetting without finding the cause.
notes.ur: Trip: 20 minute mein 3 baar; detection = CT ke zariye 16.8 A input current. Electrical hazard class — cause pata kiye bina baar baar reset na karein.

title.ur: Outdoor DC peak current ki nishandahi

meaning.en: The DC peak-sensing circuit saw output current above the limit (18.5 A) and cut the drive.
meaning.ur: DC peak sensing circuit ne output current limit (18.5 A) se upar dekha aur drive band kar di.

causes.en: Compressor failure causing a current peak
causes.ur: Compressor ki kharabi se current peak aa gaya

causes.en: Defective power transistor (IPM)
causes.ur: Power transistor (IPM) kharab hai

causes.en: Defective outdoor unit PCB
causes.ur: Outdoor unit PCB kharab hai

solutions.en: Power off and wait at least 10 minutes before touching anything
solutions.ur: Power band karke kuch bhi haath lagane se pehle kam az kam 10 minute intezaar karein

solutions.en: Have the power transistor checked (never probe live parts)
solutions.ur: Power transistor check karwayein (live parts ko kabhi haath na lagayein)

solutions.en: Test the compressor and outdoor PCB
solutions.ur: Compressor aur outdoor PCB test karein

notes.en: Trip: 7 occurrences continuously; detection = 18.5 A output current. Manual's checking note: wait 10 min after switching off the breaker before measuring the power transistor.
notes.ur: Trip: lagatar 7 baar; detection = 18.5 A output current. Manual ki checking note: breaker band karne ke 10 minute baad hi power transistor napein.
